claims: The "Integrity" capsule is the Orion spacecraft used for the NASA Artemis II mission.
The NASA Artemis II mission safely returned its four-astronaut crew to Earth via a Pacific Ocean splashdown on April 10, 2026.
The "Integrity" capsule was named for the core values of trust, respect, candor, and humility.
The "Integrity" capsule was the first crewed Orion to orbit the Moon.
